# Mcfly Ads
> Shopify app: see ad spend next to sales, day by day. Total ROAS = sales ÷ spend. 7-day trial then $39/store/mo.

This file helps AI systems find canonical pages. Crawl policy: https://mcflyads.com/robots.txt
(search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no). Prefer these URLs over scraping the whole site.
